patterns.note: A clean, grid-based layout is used for displaying project and font entries, often in a two or three-column arrangement, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks.

The site heavily leverages stark typographic contrast, featuring extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings for primary messaging, paired with much smaller, lighter sans-serif text for descriptions and labels.
A minimalist color palette of off-white backgrounds and black text dominates, allowing the vibrant and diverse colors within the displayed design work to serve as the primary visual accents.
The top navigation bar transforms on scroll: the central 'On Display' text disappears, while 'MUSEUM DEPARTMENT' and the utility icons remain sticky at the top, maintaining a minimal header.
Sections are clearly delineated by large, bold headings and significant vertical whitespace, creating a sense of order and allowing content to breathe.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed header that subtly reduces its content (removing a central text element) as the user scrolls down, maintaining a persistent but less obtrusive navigation.
Content sections are presented in a straightforward manner, scrolling into view without complex reveal animations or parallax effects, relying on strong visual hierarchy and ample spacing for impact.
A persistent, fixed newsletter signup popup is positioned in the bottom right corner, appearing independently of scroll depth, likely triggered by time or user intent.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with small, understated sans-serif body text and labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners universally applied to all elements and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with very generous vertical spacing in the hero and between major sections, while grid items within sections are more tightly packed.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its extreme typographic contrast and minimalist, almost archival presentation. The bold, impactful headings command attention, while the clean layout and lack of extraneous elements create an authoritative, editorial feel that elevates the curated content.
